content.text: In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, digital creators face significant barriers when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-selling-digital-products-africa-keeps-failing-stack-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-courses-without-teachable-stripe-explained-digital-creators|selling]] products online, particularly due to payment processing limitations. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, forcing creators to seek alternatives that can empower them. Enter GitHub Pages—a free hosting solution that allows digital creators to host their online stores without relying on traditional platforms that charge exorbitant fees. By leveraging GitHub Pages alongside automated delivery systems and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-4|Crypto Payments]] payment processors, creators can establish a fully operational digital storefront, streamline their operations, and retain maximum earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Another notable advantage of GitHub Pages is that it provides a platform for complete data ownership. Unlike traditional marketplaces, where creators often surrender their customer data to third-party platforms, GitHub Pages enables creators to retain access to their customer information and sales data. This empowers digital creators to build more personalized relationships with their customers and develop targeted marketing strategies. Additionally, with the growing trend towards decentralized finance and cryptocurrency, integrating crypto payment options allows creators to expand their market reach, appealing to audiences that prefer using digital currencies. In a world where financial sovereignty is becoming increasingly important, GitHub Pages emerges as a crucial tool for creators aiming to establish a sustainable and independent online presence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

To further enhance functionality, creators can utilize Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This allows for simple management of product sales and customer data without the complexities associated with traditional databases. Each component of this stack is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, ensuring that even those without extensive technical expertise can deploy their online store quickly. The integration of these tools creates a robust infrastructure that not only supports current sales but is also scalable for future growth. As creators expand their product offerings, they can easily add more items to their store and adjust their backend logic to accommodate increased sales volume, all while maintaining full ownership of their systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

For creators who have previously felt disenfranchised by mainstream platforms, this stack offers a powerful alternative. It empowers them to build a business on their own terms, with complete control over their products, pricing, and customer interactions. Additionally, the low transaction fees associated with crypto payments mean that creators can maximize their earnings. This approach not only enhances financial viability but also fosters a sense of community among creators who share similar challenges and aspirations. The architecture is not just a technical solution; it represents a shift towards sovereignty in digital commerce.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, empowering creators to sell without fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

In addition to these tools, creators can access extensive documentation and templates that guide them through the setup process. This makes it easier for individuals who may not have a technical background to deploy their digital store effectively. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is particularly valuable, offering all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed for building, deploying, and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack. By integrating these components, creators can focus on what they do best—creating high-quality digital products—while the infrastructure handles the complexities of online sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Once everything is set up, test your store by making a few test transactions to ensure that payments are processed correctly and that customers receive their products. This testing phase is crucial for identifying any issues before you start promoting your store. After confirming that all systems are functioning smoothly, you can launch your store publicly and begin marketing your products to potential customers. Remember, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional resources to support your deployment, ensuring you have everything you need to succeed. With the right tools and a clear strategy, you can establish a thriving digital storefront that operates independently of restrictive platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages as your hosting solution combined with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture allows you to create a digital store that bypasses traditional payment barriers, ensuring you retain maximum earnings from each sale. By automating product delivery and transaction verification, you can streamline your operations and focus on creating high-quality content.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10% for each sale.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital downloads without the burden of platform fees, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This package includes everything you need to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring that you can operate independently. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to discover more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by setting up a GitHub account. Create a new repository for your digital products. Upload your product files to this repository. Configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Test your setup by performing test transactions to ensure everything functions as expected. Once confirmed, launch your store and begin marketing your products.
